answer: Five distant attestations on the terrace board activate an identity. At dawn distances are recomputed. Within two hops it counts 0.1, at three or four hops 0.5, beyond the five-hop horizon 1.0. Each attestor locks 40 credits, charges 25 credits, and gives at most three attestations per epoch; a proven sybil burns it. One fake pays 125 plus a 60-credit bond; 1,000 fakes pay 125,000 and lock 60,000. The k-th fake needs five attestations, so 1,000 fakes need 1,667 distinct attestors. A rented-attestor ring fails when dawn recomputation exposes shared neighbours. An honest agent pays one bond.
